The Problem

Winter’s coming, and somebody has been swiping my nuts. Whole jars! All I found was this shell, and a very suspicious tail-shaped smudge.

Winter stash: 21% left and dropping.

The Mission

I can’t guard it all alone. I need a crew with sharp eyes, quick paws and big hearts.

The job: keep the stash safe until spring. Pay is in nuts.
